homepage.body:
powered by
Pricing
Docs

The Rackspace Cloud.
Zero Vendor Lock‑in.

  • Managed private cloud powered by Rackspace OpenStack and OpenCenter.
  • Deploy in under 45 seconds
  • Backed by Fanatical Support® from the team who co-created OpenStack
No credit card required99.99% SLASOC 2 Certified

Provision an OpenStack instance in one command.

TRUSTED BY GLOBAL ENTERPRISES

1M+
OpenStack Cores
50%
Cost Savings vs AWS
15 Years
OpenStack Experience
1.6M+
Customers Worldwide

Tired of AWS surprise bills and Azure lock-in?

The Hyperscaler Tax

  • Unpredictable egress fees ($0.09/GB = $90K/month)
  • Proprietary APIs trapping your workloads
  • Tiered support tickets, days for responses

The OpenStack Advantage

  • No egress fees, included bandwidth
  • Standard OpenStack APIs, portable
  • Real engineers in 15 minutes
  • Zero licensing fees, open source

Rackspace Difference

  • Fixed monthly pricing
  • Exit strategy included
  • Fanatical Support®
  • 50%+ savings at scale

One OpenStack, Three Ways to Deploy

OpenStack Flex

Flexible pay-as-you-go pricing

$0.020 per hour
  • Self-service portal
  • API access included
  • Basic support

OpenStack Business

Perfect for growing teams

Custom pricing
  • Everything in Flex
  • Guaranteed uptime
  • Priority support
  • 24/7 monitoring

OpenStack Enterprise

For mission-critical workloads

Custom pricing
  • Multi-region deployment
  • Dedicated support
  • Custom SLA solutions

Support That Actually Supports. Not Scripts.

AWS/Azure Support

  • Tiered pricing ($2+ 10%/month)
  • 12-24 hour response (Standard)
  • Tier-1 support reading scripts
  • Architecture reviews extra
  • 9-5 Support (basic tier)

Rackspace Fanatical Support®

  • Included in all plans
  • 15-minute emergency response
  • 150+ OpenStack experts directly
  • Included consultation
  • 24x7x365 proactive monitoring
